open_source.en: Headlines span an open-source app’s removal, disputes over open-source model regulation, Matrix adoption by the European Commission, and a Linux/OS X GUI project, driving open-source ecosystem discussion.
open_source.zh: 标题涉及开源应用被下架、开源模型监管争议、欧盟委员会部署 Matrix，以及 Linux 上运行 OS X 界面的项目，共同推高开源生态讨论。
